title: Mail to an offline or authority-changed peer is durable but unwoken, and its relay redrive has no deadline or visible state
outcome: Mail to an offline or authority-changed peer is durable but unwoken, and its relay redrive has no deadline or visible state
acceptance: When native mail is sent to a peer host that is offline or whose authority changed, the sender's receipt and the message's current status show a typed pending-relay state, and once the peer returns or the authority is restored the relay redrive delivers and wakes exactly once; if redrive cannot complete, the message reaches a visible terminal undeliverable state with the remedy, rather than waiting indefinitely. Behavioural tests cover the offline-then-return and the authority-change cases without duplicate delivery.
The change has a clean review pair and passes the full gate.
